result.summary: The client has proposed changing the encryption key rotation interval from every 90 days to every 30 days. The Security Lead indicated that this change would require configuration redesign and approximately two additional engineering days. The Architecture Team is scheduled to review the proposal on Friday, and the change has not yet been approved.
